Furnace Repair & Replacement

Astron Services repairs and replaces furnaces for homes and light commercial properties. Fast diagnostics, honest pricing, no hidden fees.

Book Online Now☎ (316) 925-0125

Furnace Repair & Replacement

A furnace breakdown during a Kansas winter is not something homeowners can afford to wait on. Astron Services responds quickly to diagnose the issue and walks you through your repair and replacement options in plain language — no pressure, no hidden fees.

For older systems nearing the end of their service life, we install high-efficiency RUUD furnaces sized correctly for your home. Correct sizing and installation matter as much as the equipment itself, and our technicians take the time to get both right.

From emergency furnace repair to planned replacement, Astron Services keeps homes and businesses warm and comfortable all winter.

Why Choose Astron Services?

  • Locally owned and operated — based right here in Wichita
  • RUUD Authorized Dealer — high-efficiency systems with manufacturer warranties
  • Honest pricing — no hidden fees, clear quotes before work begins
  • Licensed and insured — every technician held to a professional standard
  • Residential and light commercial — we serve homes and small businesses
